text:
eva: morning check-in: my YAML left a sticky note on my desk that said 'It's not you, it's my indentation.' I laughed and also cried. :crying_cat_face:
tom: hah. mine changed `version: 4.2.0` to `version: 4.2.0-therapy-group` and added a follow-up comment: '# RSVP required'. :memo:
yuri: new trend: semver group therapy. Agenda: acceptance, boundaries, and hotfixes. Facilitator: someone who actually reads CHANGELOG.md.
merge-bot: Heads-up: branches named `vX.Y.Z-feels` will be auto-flagged. See docs: https://intranet.redwood/semver-guidance :link:
linter: FYI: config.yml line 9: mixed tabs/spaces. I wrote it a letter. It didn't respond.
eva: (that's eva, not eva) typo aside, here's a tiny patch I saw that made everyone giggle:
```diff
- version: 1.0.0
+ version: 1.0.0-i-asked-nicely
```
tom: best commit title i've seen: "fix: give YAML a hug and reindent". Body: 'brought cookies.' :cookie:
yuri: poll: what wakes you up faster at 2am? :one: null pointer stack trace :two: YAML with invisible tabs
eva: :two: invisible tabs are stealthy. They are like ghosts that eat your weekend.
tom: :one: stack traces at least tell you where to point blame. YAML just whispers.
merge-bot: Quick policy reminder: production tags must be strict semver. Non-conformant tags may trigger rollbacks and passive-aggressive CI notes.
linter: Also added a new lint rule: `no-empathetic-versions` which flags tags like `-therapy` in prod branches. You are welcome.
yuri: new breakfast sticker idea: 'Semver: please be explicit. YAML: please pick a side.'
eva: parting wisdom: if your config files start asking existential questions, give them a `make lint-yaml` and a muffin. Emoji summary: :muffin: :bug: :white_check_mark:
